info.title: VLite REST API
info.description: Experimental API for one exclusively owned database. Bearer authentication is required except explicit loopback-only development mode. Optional distinct read-only credentials permit GET/HEAD outside /v1/admin/ and non-building collection search/retrieval POSTs; lazy approximate index builds and other writes require admin or an appropriately scoped credential. /health and static dashboard assets are public. Use --tls-cert/--tls-key for native HTTPS or terminate TLS at a trusted proxy. --grpc-tls-client-ca enables mandatory gRPC client certificates. Admin TLS reload validates all listeners before replacing certificates. Optional tenant-bound credentials, request rate limits, live-vector quotas and OTLP tracing are disabled unless configured. No CORS, automatic repair or retries. X-Request-ID and Cache-Control: no-store are included. IDs and administrative seeds use decimal strings; payloads use padded standard base64. JSON is limited to 8 MiB and 16 in-flight requests/workers. Successful ordinary KV writes follow configured durability: full syncs, periodic can lose one flush interval, and none is memory-only; they do not force a sync. Successful mutations are acknowledged after commit. Disconnects and commit_indeterminate errors do not prove writes failed; never blindly retry. Backups require VLITE_ADMIN_DIR; restore selection takes effect only on restart and never replaces the live owner. Token reload reads only configured files. See docs/CONSOLE-ADMIN.md for semantics, bounds and durability limitations. Protected operations may return 401, 403, 422, 429 (with Retry-After) or 503 with the Error schema.

x-durable-group-commit.description: Opt-in FIFO coalescing for record PUT/DELETE, atomic batch and metadata-patch requests, including collection routes and gRPC Put/Delete/WriteBatch/UpdateMetadata. Each request retains validation, quotas, preconditions and its own recovery frame; this is not cross-request atomicity. Success requires the shared datafile sync. Invalid requests retain their own errors without poisoning valid neighbors. Queue/memory exhaustion returns 503 busy; failed shared sync returns 503 commit_indeterminate for all would-be successes and poisons the owner. Disconnects do not cancel admitted writes. Graceful shutdown drains admitted work. The delay bounds intentional collection only, not disk/lock latency. Other mutations retain existing independent durability. Simple exact searches use bounded immutable snapshots outside the owner lock, with lock-held fallback when snapshot limits are reached. See docs/CONSOLE-ADMIN.md.

get.summary: Read a live key-value entry
get.description: Uses an existing one-dimension collection; never creates it. Tenant and immutable collection bindings apply before lookup. Namespaces are application partitions, not authorization boundaries. All successes are HTTP 200. Unlisted methods return 405; unknown routes return 404. Requires collection read scope; expiry is checked at the page/read clock.

get.summary: List a bounded live prefix page
get.description: Uses an existing one-dimension collection; never creates it. Tenant and immutable collection bindings apply before lookup. Namespaces are application partitions, not authorization boundaries. All successes are HTTP 200. Unlisted methods return 405; unknown routes return 404. Requires collection read scope. The canonical compact JSON body {"items":[...],"next_after":...} never exceeds 16777216 bytes. Returns the largest prefix fitting both limit and this boundary, ordered by unsigned UTF-8 bytes. after is exclusive. Query strings use form decoding: + is a space and literal plus must be encoded as %2B. One owner guard and expiry clock per page, no snapshot across pages. next_after is the last returned key iff another live matching entry exists at that clock; an empty page never has a continuation.

post.summary: Admin only: suspend a tenant
post.description: Tenant-bound credentials are refused with 403 tenant_suspended on REST and gRPC (PERMISSION_DENIED) until the tenant is resumed, and new tenant credentials are refused with 409 tenant_suspended. Collections, vectors and credentials are kept; administrators can still read and clean up tenant collections. Idempotent; durable and audited (tenant_suspended). Servers that predate suspension refuse to start while any tenant is suspended.

post.summary: Public: sign in with a username and password
post.description: Starts a server session carried in an HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict cookie (__Host-vlite_session over HTTPS, otherwise vlite_session). Sessions live in memory, so a restart signs everyone out. Needs HTTPS, a loopback-only listener or VLITE_TRUSTED_PROXY=1, and the X-VLite-Request header; cross-site requests are refused. Unknown usernames and wrong passwords fail the same way; repeated failures lock the username (and, behind a trusted proxy, the client IP) with exponential backoff up to 15 minutes.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next attempt is accepted

post.summary: Search the default collection with legacy parameter defaults
post.description: Supports exact, approximate, approximate_ready, auto and hybrid modes. Distance modes order ascending then numeric ID; hybrid ranks RRF scores descending. Auto never builds and may choose an indexed exact scan, full exact scan or ready ANN. Hybrid requires v4 and declared text fields for its nonzero text leg. Exact supports squared_l2, cosine and inner_product; ANN supports squared_l2/cosine. Strict-type AND filters are validated before readiness or empty-query handling. Nonmatching ANN nodes remain traversal bridges; ef_search bounds retained eligible candidates, not visited nodes or time. ANN has no hidden exact fallback. Scalar-u8 traversal reranks with current f32 vectors and does not promise total RAM savings. Lazy approximate may build synchronously: read-only credentials cannot build, and scoped credentials additionally need search_build. approximate_ready returns 409 on missing or mismatched index identity. Use collection routes to inherit persisted settings instead of this alias's hard defaults. explain adds work counters and an auto plan. See docs/CAPABILITIES.md for bounds and score semantics. Configured provider aliases must be administrator-allowlisted for the collection, and the caller must have search authorization before alias resolution or egress. Requests cannot supply endpoints or models. External calls require explicit administrator endpoint and egress configuration, with pinned model/version and bounded admission. Provider requests are limited to 1 MiB encoded and responses to 4 MiB; connect and total deadlines are 2 s and 10 s. These bounds do not enable providers by default. Custom reranking requires 1 <= k <= candidates <= 1000; when candidates is omitted it defaults to max(k,50), while exact/MMR defaults remain unchanged.

200.description: Hits ordered by distance ascending or hybrid score descending, then numeric ID. explain includes stats and optional plan.

rerank_score.description: Optional finite custom rerank score (-cost); higher is better.

ranking.description: Present when custom reranking is applied.

409.description: index_not_ready in approximate_ready mode; explicitly build the index or choose another mode; provider_not_configured identifies an alias absent or disabled for this collection. A provider_snapshot_conflict means the serving snapshot changed during the request; the response is sanitized with no candidate, tenant, or provider data, has no Retry-After, and callers retry the whole request.

422.description: Schema or database validation rejected input; no write. invalid_provider_input covers invalid provider input or custom candidate depth.

503.description: Busy, closed, poisoned, or indeterminate commit. commit_indeterminate can mean the write succeeded. Do not blindly retry mutations. provider_unavailable covers provider connection, authentication, or availability failures.

429.description: Credential token bucket or live-vector quota exceeded; code rate_limited or quota_exceeded. Quotas require deleting records or reissuing configuration, not blind retries. Provider or tenant admission full returns provider_busy.

Retry-After.description: Conservative retry delay in seconds (1); provider admission may also return provider_busy.

403.description: forbidden_scope: the caller is not authorized to search this collection or use the configured provider alias.

502.description: provider_invalid_response: provider response data is malformed or has invalid dimensions, cardinality, IDs, or scores.

504.description: provider_timeout: the provider call exceeded its total deadline.

KvDecimal.description: Canonical uint64 decimal string, at most 18446744073709551615. Issued versions are nonzero; expected revision zero is valid.

KvNamespace.description: 1..255 UTF-8 bytes; no normalization. Not an authorization boundary.

KvKey.description: 1..1024 UTF-8 bytes; unsigned byte lexical ordering.

KvValue.description: Canonical padded RFC 4648 standard base64, including zero unused pad bits. Empty is valid; at most 1047290 decoded bytes.

KvExpected.description: any replaces/deletes without a precondition; absent requires no live entry; revision requires that exact live version. A mismatch returns 412.

expires_at_ms.description: Absolute Unix milliseconds. Omitted/null clears expiry; an already-due put succeeds then reads absent. Needs format v5 when set.

max_vectors.description: Aggregate live-vector limit across tenant collections; null is unlimited

collections.description: List responses only: collections owned by the tenant

vectors.description: List responses only: live vectors across tenant collections

over_quota.description: True when usage exceeds a lowered limit

kind.description: open means no admin token is configured and every caller is admin; user means a dashboard password session

last_login_unix_ms.description: List responses only; since the server started

graphs.description: Stored knob: graphs the account may use: null = role default (every graph in its tenant scope), [] = none, or 1-64 names (or ["*"]). Tenanted accounts use tenant-local names of at most 28 bytes.

graph_access.description: Stored knob that caps graph operations below the role default (editor write, viewer read); null = role default.

expires_unix_ms.description: Absolute session end; null for tokens and open mode

must_change_password.description: While true, everything except /v1/auth/session, /v1/auth/logout, /v1/auth/password and GET /v1/capabilities returns 403 password_change_required

Auto never builds an index; explicit approximate may build. Collection routes default to collection settings. explain adds stats, and an auto plan.

text.description: Hybrid only; at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes and 32 unique tokens.

candidates.description: Must be at least k; defaults to max(k,50). Custom mode requires 1 <= k <= candidates <= 1000.

lambda.description: MMR relevance weight (default 0.5); only valid with mode=mmr.

CollectionSettings.description: REST updates merge supplied fields with current settings; v4 persists settings, legacy default collections report memory-only settings.

V4 tags survive service restart; legacy tags do not. Nothing was written. GET again, re-apply the change and decide whether to resend; never retry automatically.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Optional. Exactly one strong entity tag copied byte-for-byte from the ETag of GET /v1/vectors/{id}. Checked and written under the database owner lock. Weak (W/), wildcard (*), comma lists and repeated headers return 400 invalid_if_match. Omit for unconditional behavior.

ETag.description: Strong opaque per-record tag bound to file identity, collection ID, record ID, last-put revision and full SHA-256 content digest. Unrelated writes do not invalidate it. V4 tags survive restart; legacy-file tags include a process nonce and do not. Copy-out maintenance changes identity. Do not parse.
